name: Talking
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of controlling our speech, warning that careless words can bring sin and destruction while wise words bring healing and life. The Psalms teach vigilance over the tongue to avoid sin, and Proverbs highlights the wisdom in restraint, noting that excessive talking often leads to sin. Additionally, faithful communication is marked by simplicity and honesty, as Jesus instructs in Matthew to let our words be straightforward and truthful. Covering faults and avoiding gossip also fosters love and unity among believers.
